svg.title: Draft component architecture — proposed first executable slice
svg.desc: Browser, platform, infrastructure and worker boundaries separate authoring and a trusted runtime from asynchronous generation. The platform independently validates every candidate before immutable approved data is published. Canonical job state and authorized ready artifact delivery remain platform responsibilities. Technologies and event contracts are provisional.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UI · Authoring and catalogue
Story, versions, status and simplifications

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
RT · Trusted 2D runtime
Allowed actions, state and ending
No generated JavaScript

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
API · Authenticated project/status API
Authorize requests; expose canonical state

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
JOB · Coordinator and proposed outbox
Create version/job; recover handoff

div.style: color: rgb(22, 58, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
GATE · Independent validator/publisher
Schema, references, actions, assets,
safety and verified ending

div.style: color: rgb(22, 58, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ART · Controlled artifact route
Recheck owner, ready version and type

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
DB · PostgreSQL
Owners, versions, jobs, findings and audit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
MQ · RabbitMQ
Versioned request, status and result events

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
STORE · Private artifact storage
Immutable approved game data/assets

div.style: color: rgb(71, 37, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AI · Generation worker
Intent, mapping, candidate and bounded repair
Worker checks do not authorize publication

div.style: color: rgb(71, 37, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
MODEL · Optional external provider
Outside product trust boundaries
